regime.name: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 11.5 kt from 296°; 07-10 h 5.6 kt from 293°

days.headline: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral): 12 kt avg from WNW (296°) 11-16 h, persistent veer (right). Favoured: right. Confidence medium.
interpretation: Offshore northerly: gusty and shifty near shore, flatter water close in; expect the wind to ease or back late if the gradient weakens (watch AROME trend).
Land-sea contrast: inland max 22.8 °C vs sea 24.4 °C (ΔT -1.6 °C); morning offshore component 0.5 kt → sea-breeze potential none (land not warmer than sea).
Over the water: air -2.3 °C vs sea → unstable (air colder than sea). Expect puffs and lulls bigger than AROME gusts suggest.
Front/instability warning: MSL pressure change 08→18 h 4.2 hPa, AROME gust factor 1.48.

History (Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band), 104 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 11.86 kt (q25-q75 9.58-13.36, n=20) when AROME said 8.05 kt (median of all 104 days). LEPA airport averaged 11.05 kt (n=104). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 50% / back 33% / steady 17% (n=6).

strategy.text: AROME trends 17° right (veer) from 11 to 16 h: play it as persistent, sail the headed tack first toward the new wind, don't overstand.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 50% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 33% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: RIGHT. Offshore wind: puffs come off the Serra/Na Burgesa valleys in streaks; look upwind for dark patches, expect more pressure and bigger shifts nearer the shore. (inference)
strategy.start: Check line bias with transits several times; in a persistent shift start at the end nearer the new wind, even if it is slightly unfavoured. In oscillations, start where you can tack onto the lifted tack freely.
strategy.windward_mark: Expected drift to the right (persistent): approach on the tack that keeps you inside the shift, and tack short of the layline (it moves).

why: AROME HD vs AROME France 11-16 h: mean |Δspeed| 2.1 kt, |Δdir| 7°
front/instability flags (pressure change ≥3 hPa or AROME gust factor ≥1.6)
AROME HD historical error in this regime at the buoy (Oct-Mar 11-16 h): MAE 2.7 kt, bias -0.1 kt, dir MAE 20.0° (n=107)

expected_observed.text: AROME 11-16 h mean 11.5 kt × historical ratio of buoy-observed to AROME-Portals (q25 1.21, median 1.32, q75 1.67, n=20 days). Hourly AROME range 9.5-14.1 kt. This is open-bay (SOCIB buoy) wind; inshore Portals usually reads lighter.

analogs.label: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band)

notes: Runner (burda): Gold Cup notes say mostly ~45-60 % of the scale; ease in lulls/chop, max in the top of the range.
Rake used at the Gold Cup: 122.5 (max loose), 122.0, 121.5 (windiest days).
Gold Cup shroud extremes: max tight 20 V / 12 D, max loose 14-15 V / 7-8 D.
Top of range is in North's V-6M/V-6H overlap (14-18 kt): decide on trend and sea state.

regime.name: Sea breeze (Embat, S-SW)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 4.4 kt from 199°; 07-10 h 2.9 kt from 300°

days.headline: Sea breeze (Embat, S-SW): 4 kt avg from SSW (199°) 11-16 h, TRANSITION day. Favoured: right. Confidence low.
interpretation: Sea-breeze day per AROME: morning WNW land breeze, then S-SW filling. Climatology (buoy, winter): calm patch ~11 h, ~215° from 12 h, peak ~8.5 kt at 14 h.
Land-sea contrast: inland max 22.2 °C vs sea 24.3 °C (ΔT -2.1 °C); morning offshore component 0.5 kt → sea-breeze potential none (land not warmer than sea).
Over the water: air -3.2 °C vs sea → unstable (air colder than sea). Expect puffs and lulls bigger than AROME gusts suggest.
Front/instability warning: MSL pressure change 08→18 h -1.0 hPa, AROME gust factor 1.63.

History (Sea breeze (Embat, S-SW), AROME 0-6 kt, 77 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 6.07 kt (q25-q75 5.67-6.95, n=18) when AROME said 5.12 kt (median of all 77 days). LEPA airport averaged 5.5 kt (n=77). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 100% / back 0% / steady 0% (n=2).

strategy.text: AROME has the wind changing character during racing (direction change +46° 11→16 h, max hourly step 32°). Treat as a transition day: new wind arrives from one side, expect a postponement or a big one-way shift.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 100% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 0% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: RIGHT. Embat fills from the SW across the bay; the Portals/Illetes shore is to the right (north/west) of a SW beat. (inference, verify on the water)
strategy.start: Transition: delay committing. In the sequence watch the new wind's side (webcams/stations upwind); start at the end nearer it and keep clear air to tack.
strategy.windward_mark: Don't take a layline early; the mark can swing a long way. Stay between the fleet and the new wind.
